Anya (PM): quick sync on schema backpressure + retry matrix for structured output launch — when can we finalize?
Sam (Eng Lead): Thinking end of week? Need clarity on error taxonomy and what's a retry-safe failure vs non-idempotent output mismatch.
Leah (ML Eng): we also need to consider validation vs generation errors. Schema-violation = model produced invalid JSON; retrying same prompt often yields different structure.
Anya (PM): right. proposal: classify failures into 1) transient infra (429/5xx) 2) deterministic schema mismatch 3) partial/ambiguous parse where automatic repair might help.
Sam (Eng Lead): for 1) we do backpressure + 429 with Retry-After and circuit-breaker. for 2) don't auto-retry — surface to caller and increment metric 'schema.repair_needed'
Matt (DevEx): SDK should expose a 'retry_mode' enum: OFF / TRANSIENT_ONLY / AGGRESSIVE (uses automatic repair + retry). docs + example.
Olivia (Support): customers will ask for automatic fixes. We need runbook: when to escalate, sample prompts to include, and opt-in flag for auto-repair.
Leah (ML Eng): automatic repair = run a validator -> if fails, call a repair model with constrained decoding. That has cost/latency tradeoffs. add 'repair_attempts' config.
Anya (PM): Launch criteria proposal: - core API supports 429 semantics and Retry-After - SDKs vX expose retry_mode - telemetry: schema.reject_rate, repair_rate, repair_success_rate - docs + playbook
Sam (Eng Lead): SLOs: keep p95 latency within X for TRANSIENT_ONLY; aggressive mode allowed higher latency. Also need quota accounting for repair calls.
Matt (DevEx): sample snippet we can ship in docs:
```
const res = await client.chat.create({model, prompt, retry_mode: 'TRANSIENT_ONLY'})
```
Leah (ML Eng): also add deterministic backoff for retries, cap at 3 attempts for transient. For repair_attempts default 1.
Anya (PM): action items: Sam/Leah write error taxonomy + retry matrix by Tue, Matt update SDK design, Olivia draft support runbook. I'll own launch checklist. can everyone confirm?
Sam (Eng Lead): confirmed. I'll include TTL-based cache note for prefix caching edge cases.
Leah (ML Eng): confirmed.
Matt (DevEx): confirmed, will prototype SDK enum + docs sample.
Olivia (Support): confirmed, will start runbook and a FAQ.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/structured-output-retry-2024-03-xx
Anya (PM): thanks team :thumbsup:
